name: Save Rumble video transcripts to Google Sheets with FetchGoblin

parameters.content:
# Save Rumble transcripts to Google Sheets

**For researchers and automation builders.** Supply one Rumble video URL and save available captions, their language, credit charge and retrieval date.

1. Set `video_url`, `spreadsheet_id` and `sheet_name` in **Video and sheet settings**.
2. Select an HTTP **Header Auth** credential in **Fetch Rumble transcript**: header name `x-api-key`, value your private FetchGoblin key.
3. Connect Google Sheets and create these headers: `source_url`, `language`, `transcript`, `retrieved_at`, `credits_charged`, `request_id`.
4. Run manually. Null/empty captions stop before Sheets. Text over 49,000 characters is truncated and visibly marked. Each rerun appends a row; no deduplication or schedule is included.

Caption requests verified 2026-10-13. Returned live captions cost one credit; the tested no-caption URL cost zero. Trial: 50 credits after verification; prepaid top-ups from $5. n8n hosting has separate costs.

[Full setup guide](https://fetchgoblin.com/guides/rumble-transcripts-google-sheets) · [API reference](https://fetchgoblin.com/docs/get-v1-rumble-video-transcript)

## Configure once
Keep the FetchGoblin API key in an HTTP Header Auth credential, never in a node or shared JSON. Set the video URL and destination spreadsheet in the settings node. The sample URL is public test input; replace it with a video you are authorized to process.

## Preserve useful rows
Null or blank transcripts stop here. Long captions are capped at 49,000 characters and marked as truncated. Google Sheets uses RAW values, so caption text cannot become a spreadsheet formula. Repeated manual runs append rows; add deduplication if you need it.
